_source: architecture_v3_specs/03_combinations.md AA_RULE_01–02 + 07_combinations_detailed/06_aa.md. Both workbook rules retained. File 11 A/B/C tier mix encoded as priority_when refinements, not as dropped/replaced rules.

_decisions.completeness: Exactly two workbook rules: AA_RULE_01 (with activity modifier) and AA_RULE_02 (activity missing/weak). No AA_RULE_03 invented.
_decisions.mutual_exclusivity: If ACTIVITY gate-eligible → AA_RULE_01 only. If ACTIVITY absent/not gate-eligible → AA_RULE_02 only.
_decisions.file_11_ranking: Within AA_RULE_01, strengthen further when Driver T1 + Renal T1. Within AA_RULE_02, rank Driver T1 above Driver T2 via priority_when.
_decisions.susceptibility: SUSCEPTIBILITY/HEREDITARY never in requires; cannot replace driver or renal.

priority_when.note: Workbook Priority A. File 11 strongest form is Driver T1 + Renal T1 + ACTIVITY; still Priority A when DRIVER/RENAL are only Tier 2 as long as ACTIVITY is present.

combinations.note: Driver + renal transition is the disease-shaped combination. Persistent inflammatory activity strengthens priority but is not an independent third bucket.

priority_when.note: Workbook Priority B. File 11 softest Driver-T2 form demotes to C without inventing a third rule_id.

combinations.note: Use when activity data are missing/weak. Family/genetic susceptibility can modify priority but cannot replace driver or renal evidence.

_notes: Driver + ACTIVITY without RENAL never passes AA — high-risk inflammatory only.
